input: ADJUDICATION_SHEET.csv produced by `c13_coding.py adjsheet` after both coders return: only the items whose codings differ, each shown as coding X and coding Y (which coder is X is decided per item from a secret per-run seed; the key and seed are sealed in ADJUDICATION_KEY.csv and are not given to you)
rules: Read the source PDF yourself (verify sha256) before deciding; do not choose by majority or by which coding looks more careful.
Return one row per unit for every item on the sheet and no other item.
Use the same vocabulary as the coding guide; 'unclear' is allowed.
If the item cannot be coded, return one row with notes = 'UNCODABLE:<CODE>' (codes in the coding guide); it stays in the sample and is reported, never replaced.
